result.summary: Found several visual/layout issues: truncated restaurant names and cut-off category chips, partial off-screen cards, and a large empty gap under the promo banner.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row, and the third card is only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap or use ellipsis consistently, and give horizontal carousels enough peek/padding so labels remain fully readable.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow the screen; 'Healthy' is clipped and further options are cut off on the right with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with visible fade/peek of the next chip, or wrap/resize chips so all labels stay fully visible.

issues.description: Large empty white space between the green promo banner and the 'Fastest near you' section makes the layout look broken or sparse.
issues.suggestion: Tighten vertical spacing between the banner and the next section header for a denser, more intentional layout.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza) is heavily cropped with only the top portion visible, which can look like a broken or incomplete section.
issues.suggestion: Ensure list cards have consistent height/safe area above the tab bar so key imagery and labels aren’t awkwardly cut off mid-scroll.
